label: late original positions and <DEL> in sequences starting with l
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.02% of steps). It fires almost only in sequences whose first token is l (83% of activation mass), at late original-phase steps (t = 5..8) and at the <DEL> step. It never fires in the copy phase or at t < 4. The strongest activations are on input u (46% of mass, about 12x lift) and on <DEL>. They are higher when the second token is 0 or i and when n, z, v or j appeared earlier. Recall of the predicate is about 80%, but precision is only about 2.5%: most l-initial sequences never activate it, so it seems to pick out a specific, hard-to-describe hidden-state combination within l-initial sequences. Adding orig(1) in {0, i} or prior n/z/v/j raises precision to about 23% but drops recall to about 27%. The roughly 18% of mass outside the predicate is mostly weak firing on input u late in sequences that do not start with l.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+6.81), orig1=0 (+4.04), orig2=n (+3.08), orig3=n (+3.05), orig2=j (+2.95), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=u (+2.72). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.23), phase=2 (-3.87), t=4 (-3.09), t=3 (-2.76).
